title: Ortiz Ceballos, Berger and Cendes (2026): Discovery of radio emission from the exoplanet beta Pictoris b

evidence.locator: Abstract and Extended Data Tables 1 and 3: MeerKAT bursts at 0.85 to 3.5 GHz over four epochs in 2025 and 2026, 40-70% circularly polarised, electron cyclotron maser emission implying a field of at least 1.25 kG; brightest L-band burst 307 microjansky, quiescent S-band 48 microjansky; radio source coincident with planet b (R = 1.1) and 4.4 sigma from the star
